POSTURE, PAIN & MOVEMENT DURING UPSC PREPARATION
🔗 Register for the free offline workshop: https://shorturl.at/xhZuA

📅 25 October | 10 AM  
📍 LevelUp IAS, Karol Bagh, New Delhi  

Can you prepare for UPSC for 8–10 hours a day without neglecting your health? Sonali Ma’am and Dr. Rachita Luthra discuss how long sitting hours can affect your body, why physical activity matters, and when it’s time to consult a physiotherapist instead of relying on home remedies.

Dr. Rachita Luthra joins LevelUp IAS to answer common questions about posture, long sitting hours and discomfort during UPSC preparation.

In conversation with Sonali Ma’am, Counselling Psychologist & UPSC Mindset Coach.

📞 For queries: 8826496658
